title: classified.can_report_message
description: The `can_report` policy callback for stapel-moderation's `chat_message` target type: may this reporter complain about that message? The target_key is `<conversation_id>:<message_id>`, and the conversation half is what makes the question answerable — this composite holds the only table in the fleet that says who the two parties of a classified conversation are. Answers {"allowed": bool, "reason"?: string}. Fail-CLOSED: a malformed key, an unbound conversation or an outsider all answer false.
